name: fulcrum
description: Query Amazon MSK (Kafka) clusters and AWS Glue Schema Registry from Claude Code using IAM auth: topics, consumer groups and lag, consumers, schemas and diffs, cluster health. Read-only.

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: Region of your MSK cluster and Glue registry, e.g. us-east-1. Leave empty to use AWS_REGION from your environment.

aws_profile.title: AWS profile
aws_profile.description: Named profile from ~/.aws/config (SSO profiles work). Leave empty to use AWS_PROFILE or the default credential chain. Fulcrum never stores credentials.

iam_role_arn.title: IAM role ARN
iam_role_arn.description: Role to assume for MSK, Glue and CloudWatch access, e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/FulcrumReadOnly. Your base credentials (profile/SSO/keys) are used only to assume it. Leave empty to use your credentials directly.

iam_role_external_id.title: IAM role external ID
iam_role_external_id.description: Only if the role's trust policy requires an external ID. Leave empty otherwise.

bootstrap_brokers.title: MSK bootstrap brokers
bootstrap_brokers.description: SASL/IAM broker endpoint(s), comma-separated host:port, e.g. b-1.mycluster.abc123.c2.kafka.us-east-1.amazonaws.com:9098. When set, Fulcrum connects to these brokers directly and the cluster ARN becomes optional.

msk_cluster_arn.title: MSK cluster ARN
msk_cluster_arn.description: Cluster to query. Optional when bootstrap brokers are set (adds cluster state, version and CloudWatch metrics). Leave empty to use MSK_CLUSTER_ARN, or to auto-select when the region has exactly one cluster.

glue_registry_name.title: Glue registry name
glue_registry_name.description: Limit schema commands to one registry. Leave empty for all registries.

lag_threshold.title: Lag threshold
lag_threshold.description: Total consumer-group lag above which /fulcrum health flags a group.

cache_ttl.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cache_ttl.description: How long to reuse results before fetching again. 0 disables caching.
